name: Cassette Futurism
garments: not primarily a fashion look — a product and interface design aesthetic (chunky buttons, cathode-ray screens, cassette decks)

media.title: Alien (1979) production design
media.note: a frequently cited touchstone for its analog-tech interiors

reacts_against: sleek, minimal modern tech design, imagining advanced computers and spacecraft built with the chunky, analog, tape-deck technology of the 1970s-80s instead.

findings: mostly muted — about 81% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from the Aesthetics Wiki images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
